thesis: The page is the repair order form: each section writes a numbered line with a status chip and a labor clock, and the signature is the orange Your yes line that gates every repair line below it.

signature.name: Repair Order Line
signature.summary: A .ro-line primitive with mono line number, status chip (waiting/doing/done), description slot, and right-aligned labor clock; appears in hero, process story, services, and footer with per-section variation.

layoutMoves: service cards as sample line items

motion.intro: Line 01 chip flips waiting to doing, clock starts at 0:00; 1.1s, skippable
stories: process lines write in via clip-path wipe
